Done — budget exhausted (6/6 practice runs used) and the final `solution.py` passed the graded check.

**One-line summary:** W4A16 fused unpack+dequant GEMM implemented as three Triton kernels in `solution.py` — a split-K streaming decode kernel (`_w4a16_gemv_split`, masks compiled out for vectorized int4 loads) for M=1, a tensor-core mainloop kernel (`_w4a16_dot`) for M>1, both validated at setup against an independently written reference kernel — giving `status: correct` (all 5 shapes × 3 seeds × 3 stress cases) with peak_fraction 0.204 (geomean, up from 0.132), i.e. 48µs for M=1/N=12288 (0.31), 27µs for M=1/N=4096 (0.18), 69µs/60µs for M=32/M=16 (0.22/0.29) and 203µs for M=256 (0.096).
